A chart of the data at this point; double-click to open it and pick the plot type.

Connect any table: a Data Input, a transform or an evaluation node. Only the nodes above the plot run, in the background; nodes that run only inside training cannot be plotted yet and the node says so. The plot type, columns and labels are saved in the node; the data is read again, never saved in the graph.

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| plot_spec | `plot_spec` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Plot settings (set in the Plot window) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
